mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.`name` AS owner_name, u.id_card AS owner_id_card FROM owner_car c LEFT JOIN room_user u ON c.owner_id = u.id
SELECT c.*, u.`name` AS owner_name, u.id_card AS owner_id_card FROM owner_car c LEFT JOIN room_user u ON c.owner_id = u.id WHERE car_number = #{carNumber}
SELECT c.*, u.`name` AS owner_name, u.id_card AS owner_id_card FROM owner_car c LEFT JOIN room_user u ON c.owner_id = u.id WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO owner_car (car_number, car_type, car_brand, car_color, owner_id) VALUES (#{carNumber}, #{carType}, #{carBrand}, #{carColor}, #{ownerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE owner_car SET car_number = #{carNumber}, car_type = #{carType}, car_brand = #{carBrand}, car_color = #{carColor}, owner_id = #{ownerId} WHERE id = #{id}
